profile.headline: Sr. Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
Senior Full-Stack Web Developer with 15+ years of experience designing, building, and optimizing production web platforms across WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, HubSpot, and custom stacks. Currently leading WebBoost.dev, where I architect performance-optimization systems that measurably improve Core Web Vitals and page-load times for client sites.
 
My background spans healthcare (Sutter Health), SaaS (Kareo), enterprise manufacturing (Quantum, ATEN), and a long freelance track record giving me the range to jump between custom theme/plugin development, marketing-tech integrations, and full-stack application work without friction.
 
What I'm strongest at: WordPress (custom themes, plugins, multisite) · PHP · MySQL · JavaScript / TypeScript · React · Next.js · REST API integration · Web performance & Core Web Vitals · ADA/WCAG accessibility · Marketing automation (HubSpot, Marketo) · AI / OpenAI integration for lead-gen and content tooling
 
Current stack: WordPress · PHP · Next.js · React · TypeScript · Tailwind · Node.js · MySQL · Shopify · HubSpot · Git · AWS (S3, CloudFront, Lambda) · Vercel
 
Open to full-time roles and high-leverage freelance engagements where a hands-on senior dev can own outcomes end-to-end.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Senior Web Application Engineer supporting IEEE’s web platforms, including WordPress/PHP maintenance, frontend development, performance optimization, accessibility, and modern web application initiatives.
Working across WordPress, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Next.js, REST APIs, and enterprise web infrastructure to help maintain and evolve high-traffic digital properties.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
- Lead the development and implementation of WebBoost.dev's performance optimization technology across multiple platforms (Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Wix, and custom sites) 
- Architect scalable solutions that automatically identify and resolve website performance bottlenecks 
- Develop and maintain our proprietary speed optimization algorithms and core codebase 
- Collaborate with cross-functional client teams to implement new features that translate technical metrics into business impact
positions.insights: Skills: Vercel V0 · Node.js · Tailwind CSS · HubSpot · React.js · Next.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Web Developer at Sutter Health
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained responsive web page templates for healthcare system websites, ensuring ADA compliance and WCAG guidelines.
• Managed internal Git repositories and technical documentation for efficient dev team collaboration.
• Supported multisite WordPress blog infrastructure and collaborated on enterprise-level healthcare platform updates.
positions.insights: Skills: SASS · CSS · JavaScript · Vercel V0 · Node.js · Backbone.js · WordPress · HTML · TypeScript · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized Kareo's web site and portal applications to enhance user experience.
• Assisted the marketing team with online advertising efforts by creating landing pages and micro sites.
• Collaborated with Customer Support and Engineering teams on web integration projects for seamless user interactions.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Drupal · PHP · API Development · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Web Developer / Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Managed development and implementation of Quantum's web applications for various departments.
• Collaborated with Customer Support and Engineering teams on web integration projects.
• Developed custom web applications to meet the needs of Sales, Marketing, Service, Quality, Engineering, and Finance functions.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Oracle SQL · Front-End Development · Vercel V0 · Java

positions.title: Web Developer / Webmaster
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained the IOGEAR website, integrated custom webtools, and evaluated software and hardware requirements for ATEN Technology in Irvine.
• Maintained web databases, coordinated with resources to update the website, and troubleshooted issues with 3rd party applications.
• Ensured the overall look-and-feel of the website layout, synced applications between intranet PM database and web sites, and maintained back-end web databases.
positions.insights: Skills: Content Management Systems (CMS) · .NET · Front-End Development · PHP
